source_record.title: Global Observability from Negative Gramian Curvature
source_record.statement: For the observed system $\dot{x}=f(x)$, $y=h(x)$ on an $n$-dimensional manifold, let $P(x_0)=\int_0^T\Phi(t)^TH(t)^TH(t)\Phi(t)\,dt$ be the local observability Gramian along the trajectory from $x_0$. If $P(x_0)$ is uniformly positive definite and bounded, does uniform negative curvature of the resulting Riemannian metric, together with geodesic completeness, imply global observability on $[0,T]$?
source_record.background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Control Theory: On the Way to New Application Fields (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/11, pp. 593--680](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2009/11)
